title: Local SQLite Runtime
globalSafetyRules: Implement one subphase at a time.
Local SQLite writes may only target local-state/runtime and must require explicit local DB flags.

Do not enable hosted DBs, production DBs, provider/model calls, agent dispatch, tool execution, worker execution, project creation, project mutation, deploy, release, export, package creation, network calls, or provider spend.
Do not modify projects/**, careloop/**, generated app Sources/Tests, providers/**, tools/**, worker-runtime/**, prisma/**, migrations/**, deploy/**, release/**, exports/**, packages/**, or .env*.
Do not expose raw DB paths, raw DB URLs, private IDs, secrets, raw JSON, raw logs, or fake runnable actions in primary UX.

subphases.objective: Add a guarded local SQLite runtime foundation and init command.

expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.dataShape: SQLite runtime status includes phase, mode, dbPath, sqliteCliAvailable, dbExists, dbWritesEnabled, sqliteLiveAllowed, productionDbAllowed false, externalDbAllowed false, fileFallbackRequired true, ready, and nextAction.

subphases.commandCenterUxRequirements: Preserve existing Durable State UX. The /db API may expose display-safe sqlite status fields but must not show raw DB URLs, raw logs, raw JSON, secrets, private IDs, hosted DB actions, or fake runnable actions.
playwrightTests: No Command Center route change in P92.1.
P92.4 must add focused Command Center coverage.
finalSafetyChecks: Confirm default DB mode remains non-writing.
Confirm local SQLite writes require explicit flags.
Confirm SQLite DB path cannot leave local-state/runtime.
Confirm no provider/model, agent, worker, tool, project mutation, deploy, release, package, network, hosted DB, or spend behavior is enabled.
gitCommands: git commit -m "feat(nexus): add local sqlite runtime foundation"

subphases.objective: Add a guarded SQLite CRUD repository core for NEXUS OS schema entities.

expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.dataShape: CRUD records use db/schema.json entity field names in JavaScript and SQLite snake_case columns internally. Arrays/objects are stored as JSON text. validateSqliteCrudRepository returns phase, entityCount, entities, sqliteLiveAllowed, dbWritesEnabled, fileFallbackRequired, mutationGate, and rawSqlAccepted false.

subphases.commandCenterUxRequirements: No Command Center route change in P92.2. Preserve primary UX and do not display raw SQL, raw DB paths, raw private IDs, raw logs, raw JSON, fake runnable actions, hosted DB controls, or provider spend controls.
playwrightTests: No Command Center route change in P92.2.
P92.4 must add focused Command Center DB live state coverage.
finalSafetyChecks: Confirm CRUD entity names and fields are schema allowlisted.
Confirm no raw SQL input is accepted.
Confirm writes require explicit sqlite-live and write-enable flags.
Confirm no provider/model, agent, worker, tool, project mutation, deploy, release, package, network, hosted DB, or spend behavior is enabled.
gitCommands: git commit -m "feat(nexus): add sqlite crud repository core"
